api.description: role: Coach | Player. Coach may send team_action=create with team_name (and optional description) to create a team, or team_code to request joining one, or neither to register teamless. Player may send team_code to request joining, or omit it to register teamless. riot_id is required for Player and prohibited for Coach.

api.description: Create a queuing session for the team and join the calling Coach as its first participant. Auth: any active Coach (main or assistant). 422 if the team already has a queuing or in_progress session (a session in processing does NOT block a new one). The session's Timeline row is not created here; it is created when the session is completed and enters processing. Captures data.session.id into the session_id environment variable.

responses.name: Still processing
responses.description: Returned while the session status is processing.

api.description: Return one session and its active participants. Auth: any active member of the session's team. Returns 409 ("This session is still processing.") while the session is in processing, because the analysis pipeline is mid-run and there is no coherent single-session view yet; read progress from Index Session instead. 404 for a non-member.

Join the session as an active team member while it is queuing. Idempotent: joining again is a no-op success, and a member who had left is reactivated. The caller's current team role is snapshotted onto the participant row. 403 for a non-member, 409/403 once the session is no longer queuing.

List the team's sessions. Auth: any active team member. Returns data.live_session (the single queuing or in_progress session, or null) and a paginated data.past_sessions list of everything else. A session in processing is not "live": it appears in past_sessions, and its entry carries a transcription progress block, e.g. "transcription": { "total": 5, "completed": 3, "failed": 0 }. Entries that are not processing omit that key. Query: per_page (1-100, default 15), sort (asc|desc, default desc), search (substring of session_name).

Record the caller's own consent for this session, moving their participant status needs_consent -> ready. Auth: any active team member; it always acts on your own participant row. 422 if you are a Coach, not a participant, or the session has already moved past the consent point. Calling again once ready is a no-op success.

Start a queuing session (queuing -> in_progress) and move every consented player to recording. Auth: any active Coach on the session's team. 422 unless the session is queuing, has at least one player, and every present player has consented.

Cancel a queuing or in_progress session (-> cancelled). Auth: any active Coach on the session's team. Persists no recordings; every active participant is marked as having left. 422 if the session is in processing (its recording is done and stored, so it can no longer be cancelled) or already cancelled.

parameters.name: players[0][audio]
parameters.description: Player #0 audio: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg, or webm. Up to 200 MB.

parameters.name: players[0][video]
parameters.description: Player #0 video: mp4, webm, mov, or mkv. Up to 2 GB.

parameters.name: players[1][audio]
parameters.description: Player #1 audio: mp3, wav, m4a, aac, ogg, or webm. Up to 200 MB.

parameters.name: players[1][video]
parameters.description: Player #1 video: mp4, webm, mov, or mkv. Up to 2 GB.

api.description: Complete an in_progress session. Send a players[] form-data slot for every recording player, each a user_id plus an optional audio and video file. The submitted user_ids must match the recording roster exactly, and at least one slot must hold both files. The call stores whatever files arrived, creates the session's Timeline, moves the session in_progress -> processing, sweeps every recording participant to completed, then queues one AssemblyAI transcription job per stored AOD (audio only; the VOD is stored, not transcribed). The 200 response's data.session.status is "processing". A player who sent nothing still gets swept, with no record row. Auth: any active Coach on the session's team. 422 on wrong status, a roster mismatch, or no full pair. Add or remove players[N] rows in the Body tab to match your roster.

moduleSettings.name: Default module
moduleSettings.description: Auth, profile, team, and session endpoints for the AOD backend. Import the accompanying environment too. Run Login or Register once and the token variable fills itself in. Completing a session moves it to processing and queues an AssemblyAI transcription per stored AOD.
